cohort: The study included 182 preterm infants with complete data, specifically extremely preterm infants aged <=32 weeks gestational age.
finding: Family integrated care (FICare) can significantly improve the weight gain in preterm infants <=32 weeks during hospitalization, although it was also associated with higher oxygen exposure time, hospitalization expenses, and the incidence of retinopathy of prematurity.
birth_weight: N/A (elevated birth weight was a variable analyzed, but not a specified range for the cohort)
